title: loxogramme vittariiformis
intro: Loxogramme vittariiformis, commonly known as the "Vittaria fern", is a type of terrestrial fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Loxogramme vittariiformis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
